blocks: One hundred and ten years ago, revolutionaries represented by Dr Sun Yat-sen launched the 1911 Revolution that shook the world. It overthrew the Qing government and ended the monarchical autocracy that had lasted thousands of years in China, raising the curtain on the profound social transformation China has undergone in modern times. It was a great and arduous exploration by the Chinese people and China's advanced elements in pursuit of national independence and the people's liberation.

This year marks the 110th anniversary of the 1911 Revolution and the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, and the Chinese people are advancing in high spirits toward the second centenary goal of building a great modern socialist country in all respects. At this important moment we gather here in solemn assembly to honour the historic contributions of Dr Sun Yat-sen and the other revolutionary forerunners, so as to learn from and carry forward their lofty spirit of unwavering commitment to rejuvenating China, and to inspire and unite all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad to strive together for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

The 1911 Revolution had deep social and historical roots. It was the inevitable result of the sharpening of social contradictions in modern China and of the Chinese people's tenacious struggle. The Chinese nation is an ancient and great nation of the world, with a long civilization of more than 5,000 years, and has made indelible contributions to the progress of human civilization. After the Opium War of 1840 the Western powers ran rampant on Chinese soil and the feudal rulers were feeble and incompetent; China gradually became a semi-colonial, semi-feudal society, the country suffered humiliation, the people suffered calamity, civilization was tarnished, and the Chinese people and the Chinese nation endured unprecedented catastrophe. The heroic Chinese people never submitted. Time and again they resisted and searched on the road to national salvation, showing an indomitable will that feared no tyranny and strove ceaselessly to strengthen itself.
From then on, realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation became the greatest dream of the Chinese nation.

Dr Sun Yat-sen was a great national hero, a great patriot and a great forerunner of China's democratic revolution. Dr Sun Yat-sen cried out "to rescue the people from fire and flood at once, and to prop up the great edifice before it falls", held high the banner of struggle against feudal autocratic rule, put forward the political programme of the Three Principles of the People (nationalism, democracy and the people's livelihood), and was the first to raise the call to "rejuvenate China" (振兴中华). Under his leadership and influence large numbers of revolutionaries and countless patriots gathered under the banner of rejuvenating China, spread revolutionary ideas widely, set off waves of progress, and launched armed uprisings one after another, building the momentum of revolution.

On 10 October 1911, the gunfire on the walls of Wuchang raised the curtain on a modern national democratic revolution in the full sense in China. The 1911 Revolution greatly advanced the liberation of the Chinese nation's thinking, spread the idea of a democratic republic, opened the floodgates of progress in China, shook the foundations of reactionary rule, and established the first republic in Asia on Chinese soil. With immense force and profound influence it pushed forward China's social transformation and explored a path toward the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

The historic achievements of Dr Sun Yat-sen and the forerunners of the 1911 Revolution for the Chinese nation will shine for a thousand autumns! The people of lofty ideals who fought heroically and died gloriously in the 1911 Revolution will live forever in history! The 1911 Revolution will forever be a towering milestone on the journey of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation!

History always develops in a spiral and advances in waves. Constrained by the course of history and by social conditions, and because it had not found the correct path and the leading force to resolve the question of China's future and destiny, the 1911 Revolution did not change the semi-colonial, semi-feudal nature of old China or the tragic plight of the Chinese people, and did not complete the historic task of national independence and the people's liberation. After the 1911 Revolution, the Chinese people and China's advanced elements, baptized in that revolution, kept searching for a path to save the country and the people. The salvoes of the October Revolution brought Marxism-Leninism to China and promoted the great awakening of the Chinese people, and in the close integration of Marxism-Leninism with the Chinese workers' movement the Communist Party of China came into being. From the moment of its birth the CPC took seeking happiness for the Chinese people and rejuvenation for the Chinese nation as its original aspiration and mission, lighting the beacon for realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

Chinese Communists are the most steadfast supporters, the most loyal partners and the most faithful successors of Dr Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary cause. At its founding the Communist Party of China put forward a programme of democratic revolution against imperialism and feudalism, joined hands with the Kuomintang of China led by Dr Sun Yat-sen, helped the Kuomintang complete its reorganization, built the broadest revolutionary united front, and set off the vigorous Great Revolution, dealing a heavy blow to the reactionary rule of the Beiyang warlords.

After Dr Sun Yat-sen's death, Chinese Communists carried on his last wishes, kept struggling together with all who were loyal to his cause, and continually realized and developed the great aspirations of Dr Sun Yat-sen and the forerunners of the 1911 Revolution. The Communist Party of China united and led the Chinese people in bloody battle and indomitable struggle, defeated all reactionary forces at home and abroad, won the great victory of the new-democratic revolution, founded the People's Republic of China in which the people are masters of the country, completed the historic task of national independence and the people's liberation, and opened a new historical era of development and progress for the Chinese nation.

After the founding of New China, the Communist Party of China united and led the Chinese people. Through self-reliance and determined effort it created the great achievements of socialist revolution and construction; by emancipating the mind and forging ahead it created the great achievements of reform, opening up and socialist modernization; and with self-confidence and self-reliance, upholding fundamentals and breaking new ground, and taking overall charge of the great struggle, great project, great cause and great dream, it created the great achievements of upholding and developing socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era.

Reflecting on the past in light of the present, Dr Sun Yat-sen's deep wish to rejuvenate China, the 1911 forerunners' bright vision of the Chinese nation's development, and the great dream the Chinese people have longed and struggled for since modern times have become, or are becoming, reality. The Chinese nation has achieved the tremendous leap from standing up to growing prosperous to becoming strong, and the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation has entered an irreversible historical process!

In The Fundamentals of National Reconstruction (《建国方略》) Dr Sun Yat-sen wrote: "If my heart believes a thing can be done, then even a task as hard as moving mountains and filling seas will one day succeed." Today, after long struggle, the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation has more complete institutional guarantees, a more solid material foundation and a more proactive spiritual force. The prospects are bright and broad, but the road ahead will not be smooth. We must take history as a mirror to open up the future, continue to shoulder our historic mission on the new journey of building a modern socialist country in all respects, seize the historical initiative, and keep advancing the historic cause of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

The history of the 110 years since the 1911 Revolution teaches us that realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation requires a strong force to lead the Chinese people forward, and that strong force is the Communist Party of China. The leadership of the Communist Party of China is the choice of history and the choice of the people; it is the foundation and lifeblood of the Party and the country, and the interests and destiny of the people of all ethnic groups depend on it. Without the Communist Party of China there would be no New China and no great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

On the new journey we must uphold and strengthen the Party's overall leadership, give full play to the Party's role as the core of leadership that exercises overall leadership and coordinates the work of all sides, and raise the Party's capacity to govern scientifically, democratically and in accordance with law. We must carry forward the great founding spirit of the Party, advance the great new project of Party building, and strengthen its capacity for self-purification, self-improvement, self-renewal and self-enhancement, ensuring that the Communist Party of China always remains the most reliable backbone of the Chinese people and the Chinese nation.

The history of the 110 years since the 1911 Revolution teaches us that in realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, the path is the most fundamental question. Socialism with Chinese characteristics is the only correct path to realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. This path fits China's realities, reflects the Chinese people's wishes and meets the demands of the times. It is not only right and workable; it can certainly be travelled steadily and well.

On the new journey we must uphold and develop socialism with Chinese characteristics without wavering, continue to adapt Marxism to the Chinese context and the needs of our times, hold to the resolve that our aspiration will not change and our path will not change, and keep the destiny of China's development and progress firmly in our own hands. We must advance in a coordinated way the five-sphere integrated plan and the four-pronged comprehensive strategy, deepen reform and expand opening up across the board, advance the modernization of China's system and capacity for governance, keep meeting the people's new expectations for a better life, and keep advancing common prosperity for all.

The history of the 110 years since the 1911 Revolution teaches us that realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation must rely on the Chinese people's own heroic struggle. Historical development has never been calm and smooth; it is full of twists and hardships. As Comrade Mao Zedong said: "Our forefathers fought indomitably against oppressors at home and abroad and never stopped", and "the indomitable efforts of the Chinese people will surely and steadily achieve their aims".

On the new journey we must keep in view both the overall strategy of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and the profound changes unseen in a century in the world, seize historic opportunities, heighten our awareness of potential dangers and always be prepared for adversity in times of peace, maintain revolutionary spirit and fighting will, have the courage to wage a great struggle with many new historical features, and with the will and quality to dare and be skilled at struggle, resolutely overcome any major risk or challenge that could obstruct the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, and resolutely safeguard national sovereignty, security and development interests.

The history of the 110 years since the 1911 Revolution teaches us that to realize the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, the Chinese people and the Chinese nation must stand together in one boat and overcome every risk and challenge on the road ahead through unity. Dr Sun Yat-sen once said: "To restore the nation's standing, we must first restore the nation's spirit." Since modern times the Chinese people and the Chinese nation have carried forward the great spirit of patriotism, with hearts united and blood shed together, jointly writing a heroic epic of resisting foreign aggression, overthrowing reactionary rule, building a people's country and advancing reform and opening up. The united front has always been an important magic weapon for the Communist Party of China in uniting hearts and pooling strength.

On the new journey we must vigorously carry forward the spirit of patriotism, foster a high degree of national self-respect and self-confidence, forge a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation, rely firmly on the common struggle of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation, keep to great unity and great alliance, keep consolidating and developing the broadest patriotic united front, and widely pool all the wisdom and strength of the Chinese nation, creating a vibrant scene in which all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad are of one heart and work together for the great cause of national rejuvenation.

The history of the 110 years since the 1911 Revolution teaches us that realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation needs not only a stable and united domestic environment but also a peaceful and stable international environment. Dr Sun Yat-sen once said: "If China grows strong, we must not only restore the nation's standing but also bear a great responsibility toward the world." There is no gene for invading others or seeking hegemony in the blood of the Chinese nation. The Chinese people hope not only to develop well themselves but also that the people of every country can enjoy happy and peaceful lives.

On the new journey we must always hold high the banner of peace, development, cooperation and mutual benefit, promote the building of a community with a shared future for mankind, promote the improvement of the global governance system, promote the common values of humanity, which are peace, development, fairness, justice, democracy and freedom, strengthen solidarity with the people of all countries, jointly oppose hegemonism and power politics, be a builder of world peace, a contributor to global development and a defender of the international order, and strive to make new and greater contributions to humanity.

Dr Sun Yat-sen once said: "'Unification' is the hope of all the citizens of China. If we can unify, the whole people will enjoy happiness; if we cannot, they will suffer." The Taiwan question arose from the weakness and chaos of the nation, and it will surely be resolved with national rejuvenation. This is determined by the overall trend of the Chinese nation's historical evolution, and still more it is the common will of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation, just as Dr Sun Yat-sen said: "The tide of the world is vast and mighty; those who follow it prosper, those who resist it perish."

Achieving the reunification of the motherland by peaceful means best serves the overall interests of the Chinese nation, including Taiwan compatriots. We adhere to the basic policy of "peaceful reunification and one country, two systems", adhere to the one-China principle and the "1992 Consensus", and promote the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations. Compatriots on both sides of the Strait should all stand on the right side of history and together create the glorious cause of the complete reunification of the motherland and the great rejuvenation of the nation.

The Chinese nation has a glorious tradition of opposing separatism and upholding unity. "Taiwan independence" separatism is the greatest obstacle to the reunification of the motherland and a grave hidden danger to national rejuvenation. Those who forget their ancestors, betray the motherland and split the country have never come to a good end, and will surely be spurned by the people and judged by history! The Taiwan question is purely an internal affair of China that brooks no foreign interference. No one should underestimate the Chinese people's strong resolve, firm will and powerful ability to defend national sovereignty and territorial integrity! The historic task of the complete reunification of the motherland must be fulfilled, and it certainly can be fulfilled!

Through long and arduous struggle since modern times the Chinese people have created great achievements that have made the world look on with new eyes, and have ushered in the bright prospect of national rejuvenation. Realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation is the shared glory of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation, and their shared mission. Dr Sun Yat-sen said: "I only hope that you, gentlemen, will place the responsibility for rejuvenating China upon your own shoulders." I call on all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad to unite more closely, carry forward the great spirit of Dr Sun Yat-sen and the other forerunners of the 1911 Revolution, and press forward together, bravely, toward the goal of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation!
